$comment: Pilot subset for SEC v. EquityBuild (N.D. Ill. 18-cv-5587). Rules run in order; each document is taken once. Chosen to exercise every entity type (parties, attorneys, creditors, properties, related lawsuits) with about 40 documents rather than all 822. See docs/02-source-access-validation.md section 3.1.

rules.name: appointment and injunction orders
rules.titlePattern: ^Order Appointing Receiver|Order Regarding Appointment Of Receiver|^Temporary Restraining Order|Amend And Clarify Order Appointing Receiver

rules.name: sale process orders
rules.titlePattern: Court Approval Of The Sale Of|Process For Public Sale

rules.name: appeals
rules.titlePattern: Panel's Opinion|Order Dismissing .*Appeal|Notice Of Appeal|Order Consolidating Appeals
